notes.title: Devlog #019
notes.notes:
We finish up the Job System with the Science Job Tree.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/9043fe084d305cb13a2f8672167249ca77d4a480.jpg[/img]

[h1]Science Tree[/h1]

The Science Job Tree or the Blue Shirts are responsible for Science and for progressing the Space Station.

[h2]Astro Technician[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/6c9711fc7fc8fef547bbb3134a1d69baa219a570.jpg[/img]
Astro Technicians are started Blue Shirts that do perform easy researches and basic operations tasks.

[h2]Astro Researcher[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/19fcb211639760a0686e58670f673b32fac58e98.jpg[/img]
Astro Researchers are mostly responsible for discovering new technologies and blueprints for the Space Station through Research and Analysis.

[h2]Space Botanist[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/0352647726f0b49e1e305dd12880ff00d21293ee.jpg[/img]
Space Botanists are responsible for growing plants for food and commerce on the Space Station.

[h2]Station Nurse[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/a65abbb98d84514ea1e320a26ecc5f4876b60eea.jpg[/img]
Station Nurses can help guests have been injured and perform basic medical operations.

[h2]Space Agriculturalist[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/1110298e86ad4a06c5da481465649fcf10da9ea5.jpg[/img]
Space Agriculturalist are responsible for advanced plant botany and rearing basic space creatures.

[h2]Station Doctor[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/6e352414633cb76353a82017a0b746abebd24279.jpg[/img]
Station Doctors can treat advanced ailments and perform basic augmentations.

[h2]Astro Physicist[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/5648b9df1ad23dcf224abd05e3dd34d935d5e28c.jpg[/img]
Astro Physicists are responsible for the most advanced researches including analyses and simulations. They can discover the most illusive technologies for use within the Space Station.

[h2]Space Ecologist[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/9d2b9892bf86387cd4af375446a4f1073fab7a24.jpg[/img]
Space Ecologists can cultivate the most advanced plants and rear the most dangerous creatures in the galaxy within the Space Station.

[h2]Station Surgeon[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/fc4068aa177bbf3056a9e1e1afe203b3f5175599.jpg[/img]
Station Surgeons can treat virtually all ailments and perform the most complex augmentations for all races.

[h2]Starfield Visionary[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/1db4eb45b1ed083c3021c125b4f3994a73dfaa50.jpg[/img]
Starfield Visionary is the head of all Science within the Space Station. This is a late game job and only one unit can be appointed to this job.

notes.title: Devlog #018
notes.notes:
Continuing from last week Devlogs, there are more jobs that units can be assigned on the Space Station.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/9043fe084d305cb13a2f8672167249ca77d4a480.jpg[/img]

[h2]Maintenance Tree[/h2]
The Maintenance Job Tree or the Green Shirts are responsible for the maintenance and smooth functioning of the Space Station.

Station Workers are starter Green Shirts that do general maintenance, basic constructions and keep the Station clean.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/a47a600ed3ac2c0fffb6e61b2f6ece779f06364f.jpg[/img]
Station Engineers are responsible for constructing and repairing somewhat advanced machines.

[h3]Galactic Host[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/b773c6d6b3568e8102165bebc712ebbc13f537b0.jpg[/img]
Galactic Hosts are responsible for welcoming guests on the Space Station and for cooking basic meals.

[h3]Asteroid Miner[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/5fdf1aef4b7dfcad08a39f2a6c0e8f5875fbdf32.jpg[/img]
Asteroid Miners are responsible for mining Asteroids to extract Astromin from them.

[h3]Zero-G Bartender[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/49a540b157077f7054677cc3631ab5a927c643af.jpg[/img]
Zero-G Bartenders will serve in bars and prepare drinks for guests on the Space Station.

[h3]Galactic Chef[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/1ec6221c293b7d5cbdd02be87743f19dc9dbcfc9.jpg[/img]
Galactic Chefs will cook complex meals to serve within the Space Station.

[h3]Station Architect[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/0a5f9b2495dc41ca86f3d0d6c52261036558b8be.jpg[/img]
Station Architects are responsible for constructing and repairing complex machines.

[h3]Exo Manufacturer[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/36e1743b6e728c40ae24e4983b116e4da97fba96.jpg[/img]
Exo Manufacturers will manufacture resources using Industrial Machines.

[h3]Galactic Master Chef[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/64b55cd6e79721dda7db2c265f91a2f83a984e5b.jpg[/img]
Galactic Master Chefs are top tier chefs that can cook the most delicious meals across the galaxy.

[h3]Station Director[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/5cf8a15c844b8d836b1fe89b4adda77e6b63bedb.jpg[/img]
Station Directors will be responsible for the most complex constructions and repair of said constructions within the Space Station.

[h3]Exo Industrialist[/h3]

Exo Industrialists will be able to manufacture the most elusive resources in the galaxy.

[h3]Asteroid Prospector[/h3]

Asteroid Prospectors will be able to mine difficult to mine Asteroids from which exotic Astromin can be extracted.

[h3]Starbase Overseer[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/306cae5082b4afd5b8cf6666bb6779ed2541ae4e.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #017
notes.notes:
The Space Station requires a lot of different professions to run it. Responsibilities are divided within 3 primary Divisions - Security (Red Shirts), Maintenance (Green Shirts) and Science (Blue Shirts). There are further sub-divisions within the trees responsible for various tasks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/9043fe084d305cb13a2f8672167249ca77d4a480.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]Recruit[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/a6a8da6fa44744dd02991a7c21cf5232bcefa937.jpg[/img]
The Recruit Job is where every new unit that joins the Space Station starts at. They are responsible for the most basic tasks such as Logistics tasks and minor Operations tasks.

[b][h2]Security Tree[/h2][/b]
The Security Job Tree or the Red Shirts are responsible for security within the Space Station, extermination of hostile aliens and for piloting Spacecrafts.

[b][h3]Space Cadet[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/5890651d7ffef6e8cfca9906b474eba4a1d2ab97.jpg[/img]
Space Cadets are starter Red Shirts that are responsible for general security of the Space Station.

[b][h3]Star Pilot[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/3761eb9b830eceefd19e591f570872eede2ba12e.jpg[/img]
Star Pilots are responsible for piloting both civilian and combat small spacecrafts.

[b][h3]Space Trooper[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/9c43377611bb085feceddd665a0edaf3e8524730.jpg[/img]
Space Troopers are somewhat experienced soldiers that can hold their own against hostile factions and non-sentient hostile aliens.

[b][h3]Star Maverick[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/72755c2b8d0a9702a461beb9e1d0a9f6a9ca2cd2.jpg[/img]
Star Mavericks are civilian pilots who are responsible for piloting both small and large civilian spacecrafts.

[b][h3]Star Avenger[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/4561fb5296b717705cea883fc7c6977db0bdfe5b.jpg[/img]
Star Avengers are veteran pilots who are responsible for piloting both small and large combat spacecrafts.

[b][h3]Space Marine[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/e5b0c1cc2cfdaf9959c5a2f2c7309c3e904f0f38.jpg[/img]
Space Marines are veteran soldiers that are a force to be reckoned with especially for invading hostile factions.

[b][h3]Xeno Exterminator[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/b32021b9b2de5966208528c7a641e10aa55724ef.jpg[/img]
Xeno Exterminators specialize in exterminating hordes of non-sentient hostile aliens.

[b][h3]Star Admiral[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/c275b1c3968a042d07b37fc51eebabbd3bf21901.jpg[/img]
Star Admiral are the most senior pilots on the Space Station and they can pilot all spacecrafts large or small.

[b][h3]Space Marshal[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/00f14d100598f97cc18802fa2bf24a0a4f2bba08.jpg[/img]
Space Marshal are the most senior soldiers on the Space Station and can handle any threat.

[b][h3]Xeno Annihilator[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/073d0f36d4b0bbd7e11393e1873d701e0be5d1c8.jpg[/img]
Xeno Annihilator are senior exterminators of non-sentient hostile aliens.

[b][h3]Starfleet Commander[/h3][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/ca7f88ea4bbe4cda392e5577ed8fe84d4ba28e87.jpg[/img]
Starfleet Commander is the head of all Security within the Space Station. This is a late game job and only one unit can be appointed to this job.

notes.title: Devlog #016
notes.notes:
Since the player is responsible for expanding their Space Station, our Lighting System has to factor in free-formability while being performant.

Each Z-Level in the game is a 128x128 tile grid and any one of those tiles can be a hull unit. We divide this grid into 16x16 subsections of 8x8 tiles each.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/45db38d07a318f4a34570fabd4a339987ca30a51.jpg[/img]

Each Subsection is then validated for constructed Hull Units and we designate tile clusters within the subsections. Tile Clusters are formed from the largest chunks of tiles present within each subsection. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/66f28e7c8e907945e649ce608badd1d3e48ba38b.jpg[/img]

Once Tile Clusters are designated, we assign lights to each of them. We limit lights generated per subsection for performance reasons. This will also depend on what Light Settings the player has set in the Graphics Settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/c712f46be720b449e21c7bc8ce23297093125a34.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/97516ae44084cadbb64bdc3ec50496c09b168fb2.jpg[/img]

As the player expands the Space Station, only the relevant subsections are checked again for new light spawning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/07681768566bdfd1b16b50983dbcbaae9523b30e.jpg[/img]

PS: This system is still WIP as we are ironing out the bugs while also optimizing for performance. Also, a Post Processing Profile is not applied to the screenshots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/82eadcfb4458890f41a826ffcde9704bce744239.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #015
notes.notes:
Power Grid Machines contribute towards the Space Station’s Power Grid.

[h2]Power Generators[/h2]

Power Generators directly contribute Power to the Space Station’s Power Grid. Here are 2 kinds of Power Generators - Hydrogen Power Generator and Fusion Power Generator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/5935fc11a514a476b610241c6e30da68f1af668f.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=c4wSAbE2ZaE;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/ba3b913841cc1f2d2887bcfce228c38ec13b9cc8.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=y9OGmb6JYLM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Batteries[/h2]

Batteries serve as a Storage of Power Capacity and contribute to the Power Grid when Power Generators are not enough to meet the Power Requirements of various machines connected to the grid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/de340ed093d04860388c42116925a5627e493fa9.jpg[/img]
[previewyoutube=KPq66iqVRgc;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Capacitors[/h2]

Capacitors provide instantaneous Power to nearby machines during spikes in power requirements in the grid.

notes.title: Devlog #013
notes.notes:
Air Machines maintain the Space Station’s atmospheric conditions.

[h2]Air Synthesizer[/h2]

Air Synthesizers release Oxygen and Nitrogen gas into the atmosphere. Oxygen is required for Human respiration while Nitrogen is required for Silvian respiration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/e95a953588055760acf997cc89245e601027bf8c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/3bb51b75c16d1a14d38997aa366c7f40954d1b2f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/9996a5047d155c693601a305015460f6f1e96fed.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=tauN0WjHuC8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Air Filter[/h2]

Air Filters remove Carbon-dioxide and Ammonia from the atmosphere. Carbon-dioxide is produced as a result of Human respiration while Ammonia is produced as a result of Silvian respiration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/4b54ca12f902bb2218b1e4a30ce1134b39f52983.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/c62edd80e53b2218fab868f3b0d3d8a341b9a3c6.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/058c09a83a77e390158f089cb2c830f5394077c1.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=qk-dolYcZMw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Air Stabilizer[/h2]

Air Stabilizers remove excess Oxygen and Nitrogen from the atmosphere to maintain optimum air pressure and gas composition conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/a08ff766212146064c63173ee4c57d92f6973423.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/68ee91dd7b994d0f548c35440e1dd965710b8d86.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/46cd6ef0757de5c8cf6027194d85ef184bd2b916.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=pqfo80Qwngg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Devlog #012
notes.notes:
The Gravity Modulator is the structure that holds the entire Space Station together.

[h2]Concept Art[/h2]

We wanted the Gravity Modulator to be a floating structure that generates a gravitation field for the player to build their Space Station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/bb7c0c29fae408a00c276ef9dc5639c577145d94.jpg[/img]

[h2]3D Art[/h2]

For the visuals, we decided to go with an industrial and space theme.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/bf30dca2e751ad9f072ad9f838e047b144e500e8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Scale[/h2]

The building space needs to be huge so the outer rings of the Gravity Modulator are quite a bit far away from the base structure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/5355987eec95209fe904b4f85415c68d59db67ae.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #011
notes.notes:
In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2618970/view/4483990132492337269]Devlog #007[/url], we showcased the 2D Concept for Resources, we have since then made the 3D Art for some of them:

[h2]Astromin[/h2]

Astromin or Asteroid Minerals are resources mined directly from Asteroids. These are raw resources that need to refined further.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/ddc0d9d18f29dfd5e98fe9bd69109455f007909a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Elemental Matter & Alloy Plates[/h2]

Elemental Matter are refined resources extracted from Astromin.

Alloy Plates are advanced metallic resources that are used to construct various objects on the Space Station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/eac31e25fdc456e2f9601c000ef3abf4b687bdaf.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fluids & Gases[/h2]

Fluids are different fluids required for biological functions of various units on the Space Station. These are extracted from Astromin.

Gases are different gases required for maintaining optimum Air Conditions on the Space Station. These are extracted from Astromin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/e78b6814c3d71c6d6c2671cc188b5d0f29a84068.jpg[/img]

[h2]Energy Sources[/h2]

Energy Sources are condensed energy capsules that are used for various things like fueling Spacecrafts, creating Explosives etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/82ebb124730ebaacfdb3d41b2d91ec9c572d3d9b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fertilizers[/h2]

Fertilizers are used for Agricultural purposes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/2e8d659afebccf1c5aedeb19d31d40066e1a07af.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #010
notes.notes:
This week we are showcasing the Life Support Pods which allow units in the game to relieve themselves.

[h2]Bio-Pods[/h2]

Bio-Pods are designed for Human units where they can relieve themselves and increase their Hygiene Levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/728a664d51d46786ca0d6144c5e888af83cabb58.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/65ec7694951dfd7834c2bafbc2910abd477ce2fe.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=XJEAPNl869Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Sili-Pods[/h2]

Sili-Pods are designed for Silvian units and work very similarly to the Bio-Pods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/f15a36603c87f0baaa861ecb243339e1236278a0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/2880f2a52850697f3f75a6180619a9b39b45fcca.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=LpyADQQ_G14;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Droid-Pods[/h2]

Droid-Pods are designed for Androids and work a little differently compared to the Bio-Pods and Sili-Pods. Androids have a Corruption level that must be removed every once in a while. A Droid-Pod resets an Android’s Corruption level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/56175ca38532715e945bdcbb52ee05c5b62fe42e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/246796d8f312172a4eb03f39ff94ac7095510cf1.png[/img]

We start off by making the concept which is where we design the machine and storyboard the functioning.

notes.title: Devlog #007
notes.notes:
Resources are one of the genre defining features of Colony Sims and City Builders and we wanted to make resources that fit our Space Station theme while also being interesting.

[h2]Astromin[/h2]

Astromin or Asteroid Minerals are resources mined directly from Asteroids. These are raw resources that need to refined further. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/1b7f0d7bda6481f7384bf8f9c41031701f038ccc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/7fc7fa4cb8c663ded2addd68a3b00e058105b350.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/b89345c509f44c5f5b7d683d9aeba81dfe2f1fa0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Elemental Matter[/h2]

Elemental Matter are refined resources extracted from Astromin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/0d556ab12dc89029310bd83f7db17dfb77fb61f0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fluids[/h2]

Fluids are different fluids required for biological functions of various units on the Space Station. These are extracted from Astromin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/dba9b37a8a679c77ab74563b2b9f55b5786bf356.jpg[/img]

[h2]Gases[/h2]

Gases are different gases required for maintaining optimum Air Conditions on the Space Station. These are extracted from Astromin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/dc94f651b55402f2a25a3606de4e7dc547cbc1ab.jpg[/img]

[h2]Alloy Plates[/h2]

Alloy Plates are advanced metallic resources that are used to construct various objects on the Space Station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/093a02f65ec78fa794c36502562766a05a64bfee.jpg[/img]

[h2]Polymers[/h2]

Polymers are advanced resources derived from Gases and Elemental Matter. These are used to construct various objects on the Space Station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/abc43c1b55aeeab6430fb578443cc8aa378e0bf8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Energy Sources[/h2]

Energy Sources are condensed energy capsules that are used for various things like fueling Spacecrafts, creating Explosives etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/81b2a59609d5731c5cabd3a0ac5a9d1c763e780e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fertilizers[/h2]

Fertilizers are used for Agricultural purposes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/57c6f3bb6256ea9a2a3537d51474681d2cae6f67.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devlog #001
notes.notes:
We start off this series of Galactic Super Station Devlogs by talking about the different types of races in the game.

[h2]Humans[/h2]
Humans are a race of Carbon based Humanoids that originated on planet Earth. Humans breathe in Oxygen, breathe out Carbon Dioxide, drink Water based drinks and eat Organic foods. They like medium temperature and low air pressure environmental conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/b9a905a01aa7145bd1a4132e21eb398f012581b6.jpg[/img]

[h2]Silvians[/h2]
Silvians are a race of Silicon based Humanoids that originated on planet Silvania. Silvians breathe in Nitrogen, breathe out Ammonia, drink Hydrazine based drinks and eat Silic foods. They like high temperature and high air pressure environmental conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/da933d9557b0c203d2d7f8133b28bd79c33ec0fe.jpg[/img]

[h2]Androids[/h2]
Androids are a race of Humanoid Robots. Androids don’t breathe or eat foods but need Water based drinks for cooling their systems. Androids also need to charge themselves every once in a while. They like low temperature and medium air pressure environmental conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45208703/452da11ad8c57d89b1b6ce2f58afbfe135f79fdc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Galactic Super Station Announcement
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Today we are announcing Galactic Super Station. It’s a Space Station Colony Sim and City Builder game based in a futuristic anarcho-capitalist setting. The gameplay is heavily inspired by classics in the genre like Rimworld, Dwarf Fortress and Space Haven, while the visuals are inspired by retro anime and cartoons.
